hypothesis: A decode lane that reserves its expert's mirror before the read and copies each piece of the record to the card as it lands, instead of handing the whole record to the uploader once the read is complete, lets the link work under the read and shortens the routed experts' part of a token.
model: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 architecture, abliterated weights (same shapes), safetensors, native FP8/FP4
command: make -C c -f Makefile.deepseek-v4 deepseek-v4 CUDA=1 DEEPGEMM=1 CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.3 ARCH=native; deepseek_v4 <model> --prompt-file prompt3k.txt --max-tokens 36 --memory-gb 16 with the environment in config; tok_s = 35 / after_first from the engine's `timing` line (decode throughput after the first token)

hardware.storage: Samsung 990 PRO 4TB + 980 PRO 2TB NVMe in one LVM volume, ext4, direct aligned reads
